desc: This method is to calculate a semi-quantitative magnetization transfer saturation index map. The MTS method involves three sets of anatomical images that differ in terms of application of a magnetization transfer RF pulse (MTon or MToff) and flip angle ([Helms et al. 2008](https://doi.org/10.1002/mrm.21732)). Exactly one of: .nii.gz or .nii; .ome.zarr must be present.
